market_question: Will Neymar play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
reasoning: Neymar will be 34 at the 2026 World Cup with a severe ACL tear in 2023 and a history of injuries. Brazil has a deep talent pool, so his selection is far from guaranteed even if fit. The market price of 81% seems too high, and a 65% estimate leaves a 16-point edge in favor of No.
evidence_points: Neymar suffered an ACL injury in October 2023, putting his long-term physical reliability in doubt.
At 34, his pace and durability may decline, and Brazil has many emerging young attackers like Vinicius Jr. and Rodrygo.
He plays in Saudi Arabia, a lower-intensity league that could affect his national team readiness and coach's confidence.
